# Anastrepha fraterculus group: 10 loci, 5 species, 24 specimens

Copied unchanged from bpp-seqs `examples/01-fasta-anastrepha` (loci/ and
imap.txt), where `make-subset.py` and `fetch-data.sh` document how the subset
was cut from the published deposit without altering any residue.

- **Source:** Dryad [doi:10.5061/dryad.7d7wm3864](https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.7d7wm3864),
  `Individual_Locus_Alignments.zip` (`DS1_aln`)
- **Paper:** Norrbom A.L., Rodriguez E.J., Steck G.J., Cassel B.K., Ruiz-Arce R.,
  Muller A., Gangadin A., Savaris M. (2025) A new phylogeny of *Anastrepha*
  (Diptera: Tephritidae) based on nuclear loci obtained by phylogenomic methods.
  *Systematic Entomology* 51. [doi:10.1111/syen.70003](https://doi.org/10.1111/syen.70003)
